reviewed-controls.description: Évaluation conformité CIS Benchmark RHEL 8, CIS Kubernetes 1.6, NIST SP 800-53 Rev5 — Environnement production TechCorp ERP

control-selections.description: CIS Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 Benchmark v3.0.0

include-controls.title: Ensure mounting of cramfs filesystems is disabled
Ensure mounting of squashfs filesystems is disabled
Ensure sudo is installed
Ensure sudo commands use pty
include-controls.remediation: Ajouter Defaults use_pty dans /etc/sudoers. Gemini AI recommande de corriger sous 7 jours.

include-controls.title: Ensure xinetd is not installed
Ensure time synchronization is in use (chrony)
Ensure IP forwarding is disabled
include-controls.remediation: Définir net.ipv4.ip_forward = 0 dans sysctl.conf. Impact potentiel sur routage applicatif ERP.

include-controls.title: Ensure source routed packets are not accepted
Ensure auditing is enabled (auditd)
Ensure audit log storage size is configured
include-controls.remediation: Définir max_log_file = 100 dans /etc/audit/auditd.conf. Risque de perte de logs d'audit.

include-controls.title: Ensure cron daemon is enabled and running
Ensure SSH Protocol is set to 2
Ensure SSH MaxAuthTries is set to 4 or less
include-controls.remediation: Configurer MaxAuthTries 4 dans sshd_config. Réduction risque brute force.

include-controls.title: Ensure only approved MAC algorithms are used
include-controls.remediation: Supprimer hmac-md5 et hmac-sha1 des MACs autorisés dans sshd_config. Gemini AI : risque cryptographique élevé.

include-controls.title: Ensure password creation requirements are configured
Ensure password hashing algorithm is SHA-512
Ensure permissions on /etc/passwd are configured
Ensure accounts in /etc/passwd use shadowed passwords

control-selections.description: CIS Kubernetes V1 Benchmark v1.6.1 — Cluster ERP Kubernetes

include-controls.title: Ensure API server pod spec file permissions are 600 or more restrictive
Ensure API server pod spec file ownership is root:root
Ensure anonymous-auth argument is set to false
include-controls.remediation: Ajouter --anonymous-auth=false dans kube-apiserver.yaml. URGENT — accès anonyme désactivé immédiatement.

include-controls.title: Ensure AlwaysAdmit admission controller is not set
Ensure admission control plugin EventRateLimit is set
include-controls.remediation: Activer EventRateLimit dans les admission plugins.

include-controls.title: Ensure etcd is configured with TLS
Ensure client certificate authentication is not used for users
Ensure that the kubelet service file permissions are 600 or more restrictive
Ensure anonymous-auth kubelet argument is set to false
include-controls.remediation: Définir anonymous-auth: false dans la configuration kubelet. Gemini AI : exposition critique API kubelet.

include-controls.title: Ensure RBAC is enabled on cluster
Minimize privileged containers
include-controls.remediation: Conteneur erp-backend-worker tourne en privileged=true. Corriger le Deployment manifest.

include-controls.title: Prefer using secrets as files over env variables
include-controls.remediation: Migrer les secrets injectés en variables d'environnement vers des volumes Secret montés.
